task_objective: Merge the completed dev branch into main and publish the next patch release, v0.10.2.
design_decisions: Use v0.10.2 because pyproject.toml and the latest release tag are at v0.10.1 and the requested release type is patch.
Promote the complete local dev branch, which contains local main plus the reviewed results-grid selection work, instead of reconstructing or cherry-picking the feature history.

Increment README image cacheBuster values from 33 to 34 for the new release tag.
Use scripts/orchestration-hooks/finalize-release patch on main for the version bump, release commit, annotated tag, and push.
